tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The OTECH 2U 19in X27RM Industrial Server Full ATX Rack Mount Black Case is a professional-grade rackmount chassis designed for enterprise servers, MikroTik routers, storage systems, NAS, NVR, and industrial computing applications. Built with a durable heavy-duty steel body and standard 19-inch rack compatibility, this 2U rack mount case provides excellent performance, reliability, and efficient space utilization for modern IT environments.


Designed to support Full ATX, Micro-ATX, and Mini-ITX motherboards, the OTECH X27RM offers flexible hardware compatibility for server builds, networking systems, and industrial PC deployments. Its optimized airflow design ensures stable cooling performance during continuous operation in data centers, ISP networks, server rooms, and telecom infrastructures.


The industrial black finish delivers a clean and professional appearance, while multiple drive bays, PCIe expansion support, and front I/O access make installation and maintenance simple and efficient. The OTECH X27RM is an ideal solution for businesses and professionals seeking a reliable 2U server rack chassis in Bangladesh.


Key Features


  • Standard 2U 19-Inch Rack Mount Design
  • Supports Full ATX, Micro-ATX & Mini-ITX Motherboards
  • Heavy-Duty Industrial Steel Construction
  • Professional Black Industrial Finish
  • Multiple HDD/SSD Storage Support
  • PCIe Expansion Slot Support
  • Efficient Cooling and Ventilation Design
  • Front USB Ports, Power & Reset Buttons
  • Ideal for Server, NAS, NVR, Firewall & MikroTik Systems
  • Suitable for Data Center and Enterprise Applications
